headline.title: Brazil’s Mercado Bitcoin suspends deposits and withdrawals after a hack
headline.quip: Three days after Binance, the sequel. Crypto keeps proving it doesn’t need banks to have a bank run.
headline.summary: Mercado Bitcoin suspended deposits and withdrawals after outflows began late Sunday. Blockchain firms said more than $46 million left the exchange, a figure Mercado Bitcoin didn’t confirm, and Tether froze about $4.5 million. The exchange, which has about 4.5 million customers, said customers weren’t harmed.
